summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data prep, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, deployment, and monitoring—at enterprise scale, unlike a hosted model API which only gives you inference against a pre-built model. You need a platform when you're training or fine-tuning custom models, require reproducibility and governance, must serve models at scale with monitoring, or want to standardize MLOps across teams; a simple model API suffices when you only need prediction/generation from an existing model with no custom training. The landscape is dominated by the three hyperscaler suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), with Databricks emerging as the leading multi-cloud unified option and specialized players (DataRobot, H2O.ai, W&B, Modal) serving AutoML, open-source, experiment-tracking, and serverless-compute niches.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute instance-hour (training, hosting, notebooks), storage, and data processing; no upfront cost. Savings Plans available.
platforms.best_for: Organizations already standardized on AWS wanting a deeply integrated, service-oriented, AWS-native ML platform.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go for training/prediction compute, AutoML node-hours, and generative AI by token/character; no upfront cost.
platforms.best_for: Teams on GCP wanting unified AutoML, custom training, and first-class access to Gemini and foundation models.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute instance; no surcharge for the ML service itself beyond underlying compute/storage. Reserved instances available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing strong governance, responsible AI, and integration with Azure OpenAI.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Databricks Units (DBUs) on top of underlying cloud compute; per-workload pricing.
platforms.best_for: Data-centric organizations wanting a unified, multi-cloud lakehouse plus ML/GenAI platform in one place.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.cloud: Cloud-agnostic (SaaS or self-hosted on any cloud)
platforms.pricing: Free for personal/academic use; paid Team and Enterprise tiers priced per user/seat and usage. Self-hosted available.
platforms.best_for: ML/DL research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration layered on any training stack.

platforms.name: MLflow (open source)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; costs only for the infrastructure you host it on (or bundled in Databricks).
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, vendor-neutral standard for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/licensing (custom quote); consumption and platform tiers.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated, low-code model building and strong MLOps governance for business/analyst teams.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.cloud: Multi-cloud + on-prem (open source H2O-3; Driverless AI; H2O AI Cloud)
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud via enterprise subscription (custom quote).
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting open-source-friendly AutoML and explainable AI, including regulated industries like finance and insurance.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.cloud: Serverless (runs on cloud GPUs, cloud-agnostic to user)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second usage for CPU/GPU compute; generous free tier, no idle charges.
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting serverless, code-first GPU compute for training and deploying models without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + Inference/AutoTrain)
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro per-user subscription; Inference Endpoints and compute billed per usage; Enterprise Hub plans.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source and transformer/foundation models who want easy fine-tuning, sharing, and managed inference.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.cloud: IBM Cloud + hybrid/on-prem (Red Hat OpenShift), multi-cloud
platforms.pricing: Subscription + consumption (resource/compute units); enterprise tiers and free trial.
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises wanting governed, hybrid-cloud foundation-model and ML development with strong AI governance.
